title: Per-Window Toggling & Session Persistence
items: Per-Window Toggling: You can now choose between 'Global' or 'Per-Window' toggling in the Settings section above. This allows you to hide or show tabs on individual windows independently. (GitHub Discussion)

Dynamic Version History: The "What's New" section is now dynamic! If you skip multiple updates, you will see a combined list of everything you missed so you never fall behind on CSS or feature changes.
Icon Visibility: Redesigned the main extension icon with a subtle white border to ensure high visibility on both dark and light themes within the Firefox Add-on Manager (about:addons).
Quick Access: Added a right-click context menu to the toolbar icon, providing instant access to these options.

title: Icon Refresh
items: Updated icons across the add-on and AMO listings.

title: Vertical Tabs Support & Dynamic Icon Coloring
items: Firefox 136+ Vertical Tabs Support: Added new CSS instructions below to handle both horizontal and vertical tab bars.
New Simplified Icon: The add-on icon has been updated to a modern, minimalist SVG design that visually represents both horizontal and vertical tab states.
Dynamic Icon Coloring: The add-on now uses native SVG icons with context-fill, allowing the icon color to automatically adapt to your Firefox theme.

title: Native Button Support Documentation
items: Documented a new CSS solution that allows using native min/max/close buttons instead of emulated ones.

title: Keyboard Shortcut Support
items: Added keyboard support with Ctrl+Alt+T as the default shortcut to toggle the tab bar.

title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed window management behaviors for newly created windows.

title: Technical Update
items: Updated internal title delimiter for better compatibility.

title: Initial Release
items: Toggles the native Firefox tab bar via title preface manipulation.
